scripts.build: pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 -r run build:slidev && pnpm --workspace-concurrency=1 -r run build:png --wait-until networkidle && pnpm --filter slide-home run build
scripts.e2e: pnpm run e2e:fixture && node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test
scripts.dev: pnpm run generate && pnpm run sync:local && wrangler dev --ip 0.0.0.0 --env dev
scripts.start: pnpm run generate && pnpm run sync:local && wrangler dev --ip 0.0.0.0 --env dev
scripts.deploy:prd: pnpm run build && pnpm run sync:prd && wrangler deploy --env=""
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm run build && pnpm run sync:dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
